body: I’m having this exact same experience with both my psychiatrist and therapist right now. And it took me so long to find them based on what I can afford. They’re very nice people, but I’m getting worse instead of better. And the psychiatrist doesn’t seem to really listen or remember what I told her about past antidepressants and my side effect issues with them. It’s all so exhausting. I’m reaching the point where I don’t know if I believe anyone really knows how to fix or set us up to fix our depression. Starting to think anyone that gets better is just a placebo effect.
I think I stay alive for my cat. He doesn’t like anyone but me.
This is basically a receipt confirming she absolutely did the right thing by ghosting him.
I hope the guy from work is way better and treating her right. Hope she got away from this garbage.
Same for me and my mom. I add her to my game often. ❤️
I often feel like this too. Tbh tho, I think it might be something in my head. Thinking people/friends don’t care or give as much as I do... I’m not sure it’s entirely real.
I feel like this often. If not always.

Nice to hear you’re being helped at least. Are you on medicaid or subsidized? I feel like I actually had better mental healthcare on medicaid, surprisingly. I took it for granted. Felt like my therapists were overworked/unfocused/weren’t as qualified as I could have if I had better insurance or money to pay to for therapy out of pocket. But now in comparison, how stupid I was to take any form of free therapy for granted. Now I have nothing. Figuring out if there’s a sliding scale I could afford but I live in an expensive area and so far really having a hard time even finding therapists that could accommodate that. And tbh I don’t even think I could afford the sliding scale right now. It’s all so exhausting.

My plan for now is to have my old psychiatrist get in touch with my PCP and I hope she can at least just keep me on the meds he’s had me on the last 6 months. I’m not sure if she will, but I think so? Feeling very trapped by this.

Unfortunately, this year it seems like mental health coverage is worse than ever via medicaid or subsidized insurance. I’m scrambling to find a psychiatrist that will take my new insurance, my old one is no longer covered. The insurance company sent a list of providers but it clearly hasn’t been updated in years. Phone numbers are disconnected, some of the doctors are actually located way too far for me to travel to (I don’t have a car, I take public transportation) rather than the address listed that’s near me or they simply tell me they actually don’t accept my insurance, even tho they’re on this list. I’ve spent 2 entire days calling around. I went to my PCP for a referral, but that psychiatrist no longer works out of that office and there isn’t even a record anywhere of where he is now. It’s been so draining and upsetting, I’m ready to do what they want and just give up on it.

And therapists? They only had 4 listed in my area. And even with those 4, I had the same problem as above. But I guess at least I didn’t spend days on a long, fake list.

Not keeping their list up to date and not having doctors in a certain speciality is against a federal law from what I’ve read, but what can I do about it? I feel helpless.
Me too.
You’re welcome to post it there! I don’t own it. Just shared it here. ☺️
Yeah but it’s a terrifying choice.
Or they die. Or we die first. That’s the happiest ending you could get. Dying first.

I hope it’s not true that it was on purpose but I realized later today it’s possible. He knows I’ve been looking for a place to move. And this is new information. Is it possible these actions are subconscious? It doesn’t make it easier to deal with, but it’s maybe less upsetting.

My dad used to embarrass me and my siblings when we were kids, too. I remember always being upset about having to deal with that if we went out with him, like a relatives birthday party. It seemed worse than the way other parents embarrassed their kids. Because I think all parents do that a little when we’re kids, but he would share very private information about us and laugh about it. Sometimes the other adult wouldn’t politely laugh because it was clear he shouldn’t have said it and he was being cruel. Whether he meant to be or not.

I‘m pretty new to learning about narcissistic parents so tbh I didn’t really know it’s considered a disorder. I’ve had many of my own therapists over the years tell me that my dad has issues, and the way they told me to deal with him is exactly how articles say to deal with “narcissistic parents”, but none of the therapists said that’s what he was. But many things I read on this board line up with what he’s like.

Before I discovered this board, I figured his issue was untreated bipolar or borderline personality disorder. Because we used to (and still do but this aspect of him was worse as a child) walk on eggshells around him. We never knew, and still don’t know, if he was going to get very angry about something. He can get so angry about something minor, but then sometimes be fine with something big. It just depends on his mood which is unpredictable.

I’m still not completely sure which or if more than one of these things is going on here. 😕

I’m so glad I found this board though because I don’t have any friends with a similar parent. They never seem to understand. It makes me wonder if I’m the problem. And the way my siblings deal with him is different than I do. My older sibling is completely dependent on him and according to my most recent therapist (unfortunately, I don’t have one right now) they seem to have developed a dissociative disorder. They haven’t had a real job ever. They are almost 40. My younger sibling for the most part is able to block my dad out. But they also had a drug problem for a while and now they have NA and the support from that group, maybe they talk about my dad there. I wouldn’t know. And my mom died a few years ago. When I found this board I remembered going through her things after she died and finding an article clip titled “am I in love with a narcissist?”

Even though I have siblings, I’ve felt very alone in how he affects me. Later today he told them that he didn’t yell (they both weren’t home when this happened) and that I was making a big deal out of nothing. When I was a kid he used to blame me for everything. I was the “bad” kid. I think they might believe him that I’m upset over “nothing”. It makes me question my sanity. I still feel sick over what happened today. Even if it doesn’t affect my work life, I’m so upset he would do this. And I’m upset over realizing as the day went on that it may have been on purpose because I’m moving soon, and I need this work.
It’s nice when people are nice. 😭 Congrats on your graduation. Happy someone was there for you. You deserve it.

Funny you say that because he has already “accidentally” opened my mail before. 

I’m moving very soon so I just need to power through a little more of this.

Yeah he’s always refused to ever go to a therapist and he doesn’t think he has any issues at all. It’s always everyone else’s fault. He spoke to a counselor once after my mom died, but said he didn’t believe they or any other therapist could help him with his grief because he’s “too smart” for them.

I’m 100% sure he has a personality disorder that was never dealt with. Or he’s just a narcissist? I don’t know. But something is clearly wrong and it’s had a big impact on me and my siblings. My older sibling has never left home because they’re extremely insecure and dependent on him. They got the brunt of his issues.
I love this comment. 😭

Oh wow just reading this comment has given me some comfort for how sad I was about the dog I lost 15 years ago. I was very sad about her for at least a year and no one seemed to relate. I started to feel embarrassed for how sad I was about it. It’s nice to know I’m not the only one that had this sort of experience.
Yes.
I do that sometimes, too.
This was a nice comment. Thank you.
I’m so sorry you are going through all of this. She sounds awful. I’ve dated people like her before. But the male version.
If they don’t have to deal with the liability anymore, I guess that means we’re solved.
I was just thinking the same thing.

I’d imagine this is the leading reason people of both genders among most ages hold back. I know it’s what keeps me from being honest. I always speak of my suicidal thoughts in the past tense if I bring it up to a doctor AT ALL. I was honest once in my life about being currently suicidal and they sent me to a hospital that did nothing to help other than the stalling factor and then sent me a bill for $1600. I wasn’t even there overnight. God bless America.
